entities.name: Query Ham1p-like protein
observations: 197-residue protein containing ambiguous X residues; Pfam Ham1p_like (PF01725.22) spans residues 8–193.
Closest reviewed homologs are dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases with 48.7–51.8% identity and 90–97% query coverage.
Functional assignment is supported by strong homology but remains an inference for the exact query sequence.

entities.name: Q9I6A8
observations: Reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; EC 3.6.1.66.
Hydrolyzes XTP, dITP, and ITP to the corresponding monophosphate plus diphosphate; binds one Mg2+ per subunit.

entities.name: XTP hydrolysis to XMP
observations: XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28610.

entities.name: dITP hydrolysis to dIMP
observations: dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:28342.

entities.name: ITP hydrolysis to IMP
observations: ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:29399.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Characterized dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit.
